scope: ordinary learned skill-ID list and unprotected skill-book operations; pet binding follows separate pet-flags-v1; passive/battle effects remain separate

generation.selection: first up to2 distinct positive original cpetattr.skillid entries, preserving source order; zero placeholders ignored
generation.legacy: never initialize unknown old skills from the template; trusted one-time known full learned-ID list required

book_learning.status: legacy first restoration baseline below; current probability/certification/progress governed by pet-skill-learning-v3
book_learning.provenance: designed missing original server rules; exact item-to-skill values and blood-color caps are client_verified
book_learning.mapping: original cpetitemeffect.petskillid, cross-checked with cpetskillconfig.itemid/canbenid and citemattr itemtype49
book_learning.family_and_rank: designed grouping by skillID//10 and rank skillID%10 for known ordinary book skills
book_learning.same_family_upgrade: replace the single known weaker family member in its original position
book_learning.new_family: when below current original color skillnumber cap, append if expansion_draw<append_success_per_mille; otherwise replace learned[replacement_draw%count]; empty list always receives first skill
book_learning.draws: two trusted server draws0..999, fixed once per admitted request and included in intent fingerprint; never client supplied or regenerated on committed retry
book_learning.fee: consume exactly1 owned carried book for one valid learning action; no additional currency or XP fee in this designed baseline
book_learning.binding: petbangding1 requires known complete pet flags under pet-flags-v1 and binds atomically on successful learning; unknown old flags reject before spending
book_learning.unavailable: certification options, timed skill expiry and adjacent containers require their own state/protocol recovery; reject unsupported request options before spending
book_learning.progress_table: cpetskillsuccessconfig.progress retained as source evidence, not falsely treated as a recovered chance formula

wire: ordinary Pet bean+b8 compact-count ordered BE32 skill IDs; c07ff request has six BE32 fields; only canonical last4=-1 unprotected branch supported by the context Adapter
transaction: current role lease, owned live pet, known growth/care/skills, expected skill version; book debit, skill version, inventory revision and receipt share caller transaction; stage current refresh and bag before commit
replay: receipt acknowledges old before/after only; refresh reads current learned IDs/resources/cash, never restores historical skill state
guide_limit: 2012 PC guides support named pet skills and learning beyond default skills; exact initial random selection, expansion/replacement chance, binding/protection and target-version battle formulas remain unproved
